semiconductor_relevance: High — The company plays a crucial role in the semiconductor supply chain by connecting manufacturers, suppliers, and facilities through a procurement platform.
summary: SemiconMart Technology Private Limited operates a technology-enabled platform that streamlines the procurement and supply chain processes for the semiconductor industry in India. It connects various stakeholders, including manufacturers, suppliers, and fabrication and assembly facilities, to facilitate efficient sourcing and logistics.
capabilities: Unified procurement ecosystem for semiconductor components
Fulfillment services for semiconductor supply chain
Support for electronics manufacturing and localization efforts

regional_presence.India: The company supports the expanding semiconductor ecosystem in India, including investments in FABs, ATMP facilities, and R&D centers.
